body: From the DM-183 review (orchestrator, this run): budget form shows non-round time budgets unrounded (100000 ms -> 1.6666666666666667 min) — display rounded while keeping the exact round-trip; the '= duration' hint in BudgetFields.tsx uses loose Number() and shows a duration for text the parser refuses (e.g. '1e2'); pin the person-estimate refusal cases. Pre-existing: at 1024 px the draft header's 'DRAFT REV 2 · UNSAVED' pill overlaps the Graph tab.
